# 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다.
# 3x3x3 최소회전 종목만 진행되는 대회입니다.

참가비 납부는 [대회 신청 및 참가비 납부](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCKoreaSpring2024#41342-registration-and-payment-details) 탭을 눌러 확인해주세요.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

___
# There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition.
# This competition ONLY holds the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event.

Please see [Registration and Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCKoreaSpring2024#41342-registration-and-payment-details) tab for registration fee information.

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
